description: An oscillator built from eight odd harmonics at fixed Bessel-function levels, giving a rounded wave

params.text: Sets the frequency, four octaves either side of C4 at 261.63Hz

inputs.text: Adds to the frequency knob at 1V per octave, with the total held between four octaves below C4 and six above

outputs.text: The wave, roughly 10V peak to peak

notes: mono only: a polyphonic cable is read as its first channel and the output carries one channel.
a harmonic that would land above half the sample rate is dropped and one within 2000Hz of it is faded out, which keeps a pitch sweep from clicking.
the lamp flashes at a hundredth of the oscillator's frequency, so it stays visible at audio rates.

inputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
